title.en: Delve into the Secrets of the Inetian Traders

texts.zh:
因内特贸易体的最后安息地似乎是一座非常高科技的空间站。他们建造这座空间站来抵抗他们自己一手造成的恶劣宇宙风暴。这座独特的居住站是因内特科技的巅峰之作，拥有惊人的宜居控制和保护系统。但即便如此先进的居住站都没能无限期地保护它们。

由于这座空间站经过千万年的衰败已经过于危险不宜居住，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]可以提取它的从系统中提取知识宝库。不仅如此，他们还在一个数据库中发现了因内特贸易体最重要的贸易路线，并在一台工作站上发现了更高效、对星球破坏更小的气候控制机器的精致原型。

看来至少一部分因内特贸易体的坚持没有白费，这将继续帮助我们度过风暴。
texts.en:
The final resting place of the Inetian Traders turned out to be a very high-tech space station. They had built it as a refuge against the terrible cosmic storms they had brought into existence themselves. This unique habitat is a true zenith of Inetian tech, boasting incredible habitability control and protection systems. But even that could not save them indefinitely.

As such, while the station is no longer safe to inhabit due to the eons of decay, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] were able to extract a trove of knowledge from its systems. Not only that, they also found the Inetian Traders' most important trade routes stored on a databank, and delicate prototypes of more efficient, less-planet destroying climate control machines, found simply laying upon a workstation.

It seems at least some of the Inetian Traders' tenacity has prevailed, and it will continue to help us through these storms.

# 探究因内特贸易体的秘密 / Delve into the Secrets of the Inetian Traders

- 分类 Category：项目 Project · DLC：Cosmic Storms（INETIAN_PROJECTS_04） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/special_projects/03_projects_cosmic_storms.txt:98 (INETIAN_PROJECTS_04); events/precursor_events_cosmic_storms.txt (cstorms.195); common/artifact_actions/artifact_actions.txt:637 (artifact_inetian_research)

## 如何开始 How it starts

由神器行动 artifact_inetian_research 启用（事件链 cs_inetian_chain）：研究伊涅提安商人的神器后可以启动本项目。

Enabled by the artifact action artifact_inetian_research (event chain cs_inetian_chain): researching the Inetian Traders' artifact lets you start this project.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

项目 INETIAN_PROJECTS_04“探究伊涅提安商人的秘密”（180天；科学船+科学家，技能>1）→ cstorms.195：获得 tech_storm_manipulation 与 tech_advanced_storm_manipulation（已有则改为每月工程研究）、修正“伊涅提安商人的秘密”（蜂巢/机械版本不同）、领袖获得统御专精特质（已有则+200经验）、设置标志 unlocked_hyperlane_detailer。cstorms.195 只触发一次（fire_only_once）。

Project INETIAN_PROJECTS_04 "Delve into the Secrets of the Inetian Traders" (180 days; science ship and scientist, skill > 1) → cstorms.195: gives tech_storm_manipulation and tech_advanced_storm_manipulation (monthly engineering research if both are known), the modifier 'Secrets of the Inetian Traders' (a different one for hive/machine empires), the leader the statecraft expertise trait (or +200 experience) and sets flag unlocked_hyperlane_detailer. cstorms.195 can fire only once (fire_only_once).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

单一路径，无随机分支。

Single path, no random branch.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

蜂巢/机械帝国获得不同的修正。

Hive and machine empires get a different modifier.
